attack_order_help: Separate targets with semicolons: A-1;B;C. A-D are regions; 1 is boss, 2/3 generals, 4/5/6 elites. A region expands elites, generals, then boss.
abyss_trial_mode_help: Stop for human inspection after one pass and preserve progress rather than scheduling another run.
try_start_abyss_shadows_help: Only enable when authorized to open the activity; disabled for the trial.
try_complete_enemy_count_help: After the configured route, try to fill 2 boss / 4 general / 6 elite objectives; failed targets do not count.
mark_main_help: Select enemy types for main-target marking; none in the trial.
enable_switch_soul_in_as_help: Preload distinct presets in boss/general/elite order; shared shikigami may have loadouts overwritten.
preset_boss_help: group,team: groups 1-7, teams 1-4; empty retains the current lineup.
preset_general_help: group,team: groups 1-7, teams 1-4; empty retains the current lineup.
preset_elite_help: group,team: groups 1-7, teams 1-4; empty retains the current lineup.
strategy_boss_help: FALSE: natural settlement; TRUE: immediate exit; 1-3 digits: seconds; 4+ digits: damage.
strategy_general_help: FALSE: natural settlement; TRUE: immediate exit; 1-3 digits: seconds; 4+ digits: damage.
strategy_elite_help: FALSE: natural settlement; TRUE: immediate exit; 1-3 digits: seconds; 4+ digits: damage.
save_date_help: Maintained while running; stop the instance before clearing progress for a fresh test.
done_help: Recorded only after victory or reaching the configured objective.
unavailable_help: Derived from region-sealed detection; imported assets need live validation.
abyss_failed_targets_help: Navigation failed or two unsuccessful battles; not proof of death/completion.
